_note: Specification-level flow definition, not a pac-exported artifact — no tenant to build this in yet (docs/09-build-report.md).
description: Daily summary of what's due/overdue, fanned out to whatever offices exist right now (feature 004 FR-027) — no fixed office list anywhere, per the N-offices decision in docs/08-decisions.md.

actions.name: List_offices
actions.note: FR-027: derived from the location table at run time, so a newly added office is covered with zero configuration change. This is the step that makes data/reference/office_admins.csv obsolete (see its own README) — a fixed file cannot do this.

actions.name: For_each_office
actions.detail: Query Active assets where eng_nextcaldue <= today+horizon (configurable, default 30) OR overdue, grouped to this office by eng_homeoffice. Look up the office's assigned administrator(s) (a relationship on eng_location, maintained by the System Owner in-app per docs/04-calibration-management's admin-to-office note — NOT a CSV).

onNoAdmin.detail: FR-027a: an office with due/overdue assets and no administrator assigned is posted to AMS-Alerts by name, not silently skipped.
onNoAdmin.derivesFrom: app: no direct equivalent yet — feature 004's admin-to-office assignment screen is not built in this session (see docs/09-build-report.md, 'What is stubbed'). Flagged so it isn't forgotten.

actions.name: Send_notification
actions.detail: One per office admin. Overdue items visually distinguished from due-soon (FR-029). Links to the due list in the app (FR-030). Cadence-limited so the same asset doesn't notify every single day — see the open cadence question in specs/clarifications.md.
actions.note: ASSUMPTION: cadence (unnumbered, open clarification) — once per threshold crossing (due-soon, then again on going overdue) until the calibration is recorded, not daily. Pending Jay's confirmation; recorded in docs/08-decisions.md.
